title: arena-manager groups A+B: per-file recovery decision
problem: Groups A (7d8157c5, 5dc7d7e8, b5c7399e) and B (50715c9c) of the DEC-0008 audit add a Supabase-gateway orchestrator (v1.7) with runtime state and gateway tokens, overlapping the canonical control plane tools/workforce (DEC-0001/0002). A per-file decision was pending (TASK-0006).

options.summary: Recover only the verified bug fixes to code that exists on main; retire the rest (preserved in archive/arena-manager-28eea831)
Port the orchestrator v1.7 code as an adapter

rationale: RECOVER (TASK-0006 PR): tools/gateway/providers/supabase_provider.py RPC path rest/v1/rpc (PostgREST) and heartbeat p_worker_state NULL instead of a forced AVAILABLE (group B), verified against public.agent_heartbeat on main (NULL keeps the stored state); covered by a new hermetic test (the original test_heartbeat_lease_safety.py needs a live Supabase project and an agent UUID, so it is not ported). REJECT, never port: .arena/gateway_tokens.json (compromised; owner rotation B2), .arena/logs/*, .arena/runtime/*, supabase/.temp/*, per-task .evidence/* and workspace.json, crates/arena-worker/runtime-kernel/{DISPATCH,RESULT}.json (runtime state, not source). RETIRE, superseded by tools/workforce (one Manager system, DEC-0001/0002/0005/0010/0011): supabase/functions/gateway/*, supabase/config.toml change, tools/gateway/{service_manager,worker_fleet_daemon}.py, tools/gateway/tests/test_edge_equivalence.py, tools/orchestration/{arena_cli,arena_external_worker,autonomous_planner,project_adapter,repository_scanner,run_gate2_reverification,telegram_monitor,workspace_manager}.py and their tests, the ARENA_MANAGER_CAPABILITY_GATEWAY.md rewrite, .arena/TASK.md. REJECT: orchestrator_daemon.run_forever (sleeps self.interval, violating the <=1s polling rule) and the server.py sys.path tweak (not needed by any test on main). The heartbeat invariant is also enforced by the control plane (Manager-only release edge at zero active work, DEC-0005). Retired code stays preserved in the archive tag; reviving any of it requires a new task and decision.
